proposals.tactic:
have hb_ne : b ^ 3 ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  rw [hz, mul_zero] at h₀
  norm_num at h₀
have hmul : a = (27 / 4 : ℝ) * b ^ 3 := (div_eq_iff hb_ne).mp h₁
have ha_cube : a ^ 3 = (8 : ℝ) := by
  calc
    a ^ 3 = a ^ 2 * ((27 / 4 : ℝ) * b ^ 3) := by rw [← hmul] <;> ring
    _ = (27 / 4 : ℝ) * (a ^ 2 * b ^ 3) := by ring
    _ = 8 := by rw [h₀] <;> norm_num
have cube_eight : ∀ x : ℝ, x ^ 3 = 8 → x = 2 := by
  intro x hx
  have hprod : (x - 2) * ((x + 1) ^ 2 + 3) = 0 := by
    calc
      (x - 2) * ((x + 1) ^ 2 + 3) = x ^ 3 - 8 := by ring
      _ = 0 := sub_eq_zero.mpr hx
  have hpos : 0 < (x + 1) ^ 2 + 3 := by positivity
  exact sub_eq_zero.mp ((mul_eq_zero.mp hprod).resolve_right (ne_of_gt hpos))
have ha_eq : a = 2 := cube_eight a ha_cube
have hb_cube : (3 * b) ^ 3 = (8 : ℝ) := by
  calc
    (3 * b) ^ 3 = 27 * b ^ 3 := by ring
    _ = 8 := by nlinarith only [hmul, ha_eq]
have hb_eq : 3 * b = 2 := cube_eight (3 * b) hb_cube
linarith only [ha_eq, hb_eq]

have hb_ne : b ^ 3 ≠ 0 := by
  intro hz
  norm_num [hz] at h₀
have hmul : a = (27 / 4 : ℝ) * b ^ 3 := (div_eq_iff hb_ne).mp h₁
have ha_cube : a ^ 3 = (8 : ℝ) := by
  have h := congrArg (fun x : ℝ => a ^ 2 * x) hmul
  dsimp at h
  nlinarith only [h, h₀]
have ha_prod : (a - 2) * ((a + 1) ^ 2 + 3) = 0 := by
  nlinarith only [ha_cube]
have ha_eq : a = 2 := by
  rcases mul_eq_zero.mp ha_prod with hz | hz
  · exact sub_eq_zero.mp hz
  · nlinarith only [hz, sq_nonneg (a + 1)]
have hb_cube : b ^ 3 = (8 / 27 : ℝ) := by
  nlinarith only [ha_eq, hmul]
have hb_prod : (b - 2 / 3) * ((b + 1 / 3) ^ 2 + 1 / 3) = 0 := by
  nlinarith only [hb_cube]
rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hb_prod with hz | hz
· linarith only [ha_eq, hz]
· nlinarith only [hz, sq_nonneg (b + 1 / 3)]
